about: PL-10 T1 research benchmark: 10 fixed questions, each with a reference list of known good sources. Every DOI was checked against Crossref and every arXiv id against the arXiv API on 2026-11-13 (title, year and first authors matched). The questions are fixed, so a benchmark run needs no owner approval.
